code-runner.executorMap.java: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force target/classes | Out-Null; $files = Get-ChildItem -Path src/main/java -Recurse -Filter *.java | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; javac -encoding UTF-8 -cp "lib/*" -d target/classes $files; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { java -cp "target/classes;src/main/resources;lib/*" pulse.PulseMain }
